problem: Ranged sight rays repeatedly scanned every building and every actor for each sub-tile sample.
changes: Preserve sampled ray/corner semantics while checking each rounded tile once.
Index sight-blocking scenery separately from ordinary actors.
Cache native building collision inverses and conservatively index actual wall/entrance extents.
Invalidate building query projections when native walls, portals, ancestors or scene membership change.
